WITH
  inicio AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date AS v),
  fim    AS (SELECT (DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') + INTERVAL '6 days')::date AS v),
  dias_com_tarefa AS (
    SELECT user_phone, COUNT(DISTINCT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date) AS dias_usando
    FROM tasks, inicio, fim
    WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date BETWEEN inicio.v AND fim.v
    GROUP BY user_phone
  ),
  tarefas_por_dia_agg AS (
    SELECT
      user_phone,
      EXTRACT(DOW FROM due_date_typed)::int AS dow,
      COUNT(*) AS total_dia
    FROM tasks, inicio, fim
    WHERE due_date_typed BETWEEN inicio.v AND fim.v
    GROUP BY user_phone, dow
  ),
  tarefas_json AS (
    SELECT user_phone, JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT('dow', dow, 'total', total_dia)) AS tarefas_por_dia
    FROM tarefas_por_dia_agg
    GROUP BY user_phone
  ),
  tarefas_semana AS (
    SELECT
      user_phone,
      COUNT(*) AS tarefas_completadas,
      ARRAY_TO_STRING(
        ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date::text
          ORDER BY (updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date::text DESC
        ), ','
      ) AS datas_completas
    FROM tasks, inicio, fim
    WHERE status = 'done'
      AND (updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date BETWEEN inicio.v AND fim.v
    GROUP BY user_phone
  )
SELECT
  u.phone,
  COALESCE(u.frist_name, SPLIT_PART(u.name, ' ', 1), 'Você') AS primeiro_nome,
  u.gender,                                                         -- ✅ novo
  u.last_interaction_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo' AS last_interaction_at,  -- ✅ novo
  COALESCE(ts.tarefas_completadas, 0)::int AS tarefas_completadas,
  COALESCE(dc.dias_usando, 0)::int AS dias_usando,
  COALESCE(tj.tarefas_por_dia::text, '[]') AS tarefas_por_dia,
  COALESCE(ts.datas_completas, '') AS datas_completas,
  inicio.v::text AS semana_inicio,
  fim.v::text AS semana_fim
FROM users u
INNER JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_phone = u.phone
CROSS JOIN inicio
CROSS JOIN fim
LEFT JOIN tarefas_semana ts ON ts.user_phone = u.phone
LEFT JOIN dias_com_tarefa dc ON dc.user_phone = u.phone
LEFT JOIN tarefas_json tj ON tj.user_phone = u.phone
WHERE s.status = 'active'
  AND (s.valid_until IS NULL OR s.valid_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
ORDER BY u.phone;

SELECT
  (SELECT frase FROM frases_dicas_raiox ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) AS "Dica",
  (SELECT frase FROM frases_historias_raiox ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) AS "Historia",
  (SELECT frase FROM frases_mensagem_raiox ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) AS "Mensagem";
